notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: לב is 'heart'; D4 fixes 'bel' (seat of feeling and will), not 'hat'.

notes.subject: plaiim ol string
notes.rationale: זמר literally 'to touch/pluck strings', not a generic 'praise'.

notes.subject: נכון לבי
notes.rationale: Exact repetition of the clause — resolve/vow formula, kept verbatim.

translation: Bel bilong mi i stap redi, Elohim; bel bilong mi i stap redi; bai mi singim singsing na bai mi plaiim ol string bilong miusik.

tokens.gloss: na bai mi plaiim ol string bilong miusik
